title: 🐱 Sweet Kittens and Young Cats Ready for Adoption in Modesto
text:
1 days ago Looking to add a furry friend to your family? These adorable cats at Stanislaus Animal Services Agency in Modesto are waiting for loving homes. Each one has a unique charm and is ready to bring warmth and joy to your life.
LINNY Breed: Domestic Longhair
Age: Baby
Gender: Female
Color: Calico or Dilute Calico
This fluffy little girl is full of curiosity and sweetness. Linny’s soft coat and gentle nature make her a perfect cuddle companion.
Shelter: Stanislaus Animal Services Agency
Phone: (209) 558-7387
👉 Meet Linny and apply to adopt on adoptapet
MARVIN Breed: Domestic Longhair
Age: Baby
Gender: Male
Color: Black & White or Tuxedo
Marvin is a handsome tuxedo kitten with a playful spirit. He’s sure to bring laughter and love to any home.
Shelter: Stanislaus Animal Services Agency
Phone: (209) 558-7387
👉 Meet Marvin and apply to adopt on adoptapet
A Breed: Domestic Shorthair
Age: Young
Gender: Female
Color: Brown Tabby
A is a lovely young tabby with a soft coat and bright eyes. She’s ready to find a forever home where she can feel safe and loved.
Shelter: Stanislaus Animal Services Agency
Phone: (209) 558-7387
👉 Meet A and apply to adopt on adoptapet
If you’re ready to open your heart and home, visit Stanislaus Animal Services Agency or call (209) 558-7387 to learn more about these wonderful cats.
Please note: Pet availability changes quickly. Some pets listed here may have already been adopted or reclaimed, and links may no longer be active. Contact the shelter directly for the most up-to-date information.
